using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
static long long pptr = 0, pptrmax = 0;
static vector<string> st;

static long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long res = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
            res = (res * base) % MOD;
            exp--;
        } else {
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    long long d = r - l + 1;
    long long a = d / 2;
    long long b = d - a;
    long long nm = n * m;
    long long diff = abs(a - b);

    long long ans = (pow_mod(d, nm) + pow_mod(diff, nm)) % MOD;
    ans = (ans * 499122177LL) % MOD;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = pow_mod(d, nm);
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
